rv.q: The music is hot (the often-spellbinding Goddess songs... are by Michael Thurber); the dancing is even hotter.
Its greatest triumph lies in its ability to create moments of pure joy—those electrifying instances when the music, movement, and narrative fuse into something greater than the sum of their parts.

We lay our scene in Club Moto Moto, “the hottest and sexiest jazz club in all of Mombasa.” It also happens to be the place where the goddess Marimba first created music. The club is a sacred space — not just for the people who flock there to escape the conservatism of the outside world, but in a much more literal sense as well.
It's impossible to have a bad time at Goddess . Like a so-so night out at the club, you’ll have fun, but you probably won’t remember much about it a year from now.

With a little more paring and focus, Goddess could be a blockbuster. In its current form, it still offers an evening of foot-tapping pleasures and showmanship — and a memorable star turn for the celestial body that is Amber Iman.
